what: CARRIED FORWARD, NOT NEW: MI-321 filed it on 2026-09-18 (docs/research/ict-scalp-seam-2026-09-18.md sec 5) as BL-20260918-THE-ICT-SCALP-HARNESS-CANNOT-EXPRESS-THE-OFF-CELL-SUPPRESSION-..., and that id no longer resolves -- the four review backlogs were archived by the 2026-09-21 operating reset, so the finding was tracked by nobody. This row is the carrier. THE FINDING: ict_scalp_xrp_5m declares off_cells [[trending, volatile], [chop, volatile]]; the LIVE builder suppresses an entry on it (src/runtime/strategy_signal_builders.py:797-802, `if off_cells and vol_spec:`), the key occurs ZERO times in scripts/backtest_ict_scalp.py, and no flag exists -- MI-321 graded it `not_expressible`. Its sibling vol_spec grades `asymmetric_gate`: --vol-spec-json exists and reaches no skip (12 occurrences, all inside _stamp_decision_time_regime), so forwarding it would LABEL a run with the spec while it behaves as if unset. [!] E28 FIXED THE OTHER HALF OF MI-321 sec 3 (the hardcoded _load_yaml_params read) and deliberately did NOT fix this half: regime_debt_matrix grades the leg `approximate` and NAMES both keys rather than certifying it. CONSEQUENCE, now committed: comms/strategy_evidence/ict_scalp_xrp_5m.json's net_r_oos -8.2061 (n=245) is the UNGATED arm, and the live builder's own docstring says 'XRP's pass was conditional on this gate (ungated 2/4 folds fails; gated 4/4 passes)'. So this harness can only produce the arm that fails, and that leg's Stage-0 verdict is not a statement about the leg as it actually runs. The fix is to port an off-cell SKIP into the harness -- not to widen the lever sets, which would launder the gap.
